sloka: श्वः प्रभाते तु शपथं मैथिली जनकात्मजा ।करोतु परिषन्मध्ये शोधनार्थं ममैव च ।। ७.९५.६ ॥
transliteration: śvaḥ prabhāte tu śapathaṁ maithilī janakātmajā ।karotu pariṣanmadhye śodhanārthaṁ mamaiva ca ।। 7.95.6 ॥

translations.english: Having understood the wish of the sage and the thought in Sita's mind, who desires to give proof, then quickly report it to me.
